title: DFA for ab or ba
goal: Show a total DFA over a and b that accepts exactly the two words ab and ba.

rubric.must: The initial marker visibly enters Start and Accept is visibly marked accepting.
Visible labelled paths Start-a-SeenA-b-Accept and Start-b-SeenB-a-Accept exist.
Each visible state has an outgoing transition labelled a and an outgoing transition labelled b.
Dead is visible with both a and b self-transitions.
SeenA on a and SeenB on b visibly go to Dead.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the state exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly shows a complete DFA over {a,b} accepting exactly ab and ba. Start is initial, Accept is double-bordered, all required labelled transitions are present, and Dead visibly absorbs both symbols.

items.evidence: A filled initial marker visibly points into Start, and Accept is visibly drawn with a double border.
The labelled paths Start —a→ SeenA —b→ Accept and Start —b→ SeenB —a→ Accept are both visible.
Each visible state—Start, SeenA, SeenB, Accept, and Dead—has visible outgoing transitions labelled a and b.
Dead is visible and has two distinct self-loops labelled a and b.
SeenA visibly transitions to Dead on a via the upper route, and SeenB visibly transitions to Dead on b via the lower route.
